_comment: The single list of every HoloNET NuGet package. The publish jobs, the packaging script and the CI check all read this file,
so a package that isn't listed here is never built, and CI fails when a packable project isn't listed (or a listed package
isn't produced). To add a library: add it here, then run  python scripts/holonet_packages.py check.
version: ONE version for the whole family (lockstep). Every package is packed at it, whatever its csproj says.
Change it with  python scripts/holonet_packages.py set-version X.Y.Z  (also updates the csproj files and their release notes).
variants (per library): none = the lightweight package, no conductor | both = .Embedded (Holochain 0.7.1 + 0.7.0, pick with
Only the Client carries the conductor binaries; every other library's Embedded variant depends on the matching Client package.
exclude_projects: projects that declare a package but are deliberately not published (templates, tests, examples). Paths relative to the repo; a trailing * matches a prefix.

libraries.name: Client
libraries.description: Connect to a Holochain conductor, install hApps, call zome functions and receive signals. Everything else builds on it.

libraries.name: ORM
libraries.description: Save, load, change and delete your own C# classes on Holochain, with change tracking and collections. Includes the Client.

libraries.name: HyperNET
libraries.description: Real-time player-to-player messaging for games and apps: zones, area of interest, reliable messages. Includes the Client.

libraries.name: HDK
libraries.description: Everything in one package: the Client, ORM and HyperNET. WEB5 STAR and HoloOASIS are not included yet because the STAR packages cannot be installed at the moment.

libraries.name: Manager
libraries.description: HoloNET Manager: a Windows (WPF) app and library for running a conductor and managing hApps.

libraries.name: API
libraries.description: The simple API: one line to save, load and delete data, share it with every agent and hear when it changes. Includes the Client and the OASIS hApp.

libraries.name: Client.TestHarness
libraries.description: A ready-to-run test harness that exercises the Client and ORM against a live conductor.

libraries.name: Templates
libraries.description: dotnet new templates for 17 app types (console, web, desktop, mobile, Unity) with HoloNET wired in: choose the Client, ORM, API or HyperNET.
